overview: The Committee held a joint meeting with the Affordable Housing Trust to coordinate future housing development funding, followed by a regular meeting where they approved a historic preservation grant and previewed upcoming fiscal year 2026 project applications.

items.title: Joint Meeting with the Affordable Housing Trust
items.summary: The Committee and the Trust discussed a proposal to transition future housing development and construction funding requests to the Trust to leverage their specialized housing expertise.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes of July 8, 2025.

items.title: Administrative Updates
items.summary: The Committee discussed upcoming community tabling and public outreach events scheduled for September and October.

items.title: Unitarian Universalist Church Small Grant Application
items.summary: Approved an $8,400 small grant to the Unitarian Universalist Church of Medford for the restoration of its eastern stained-glass window.

items.title: Overview of FY26 Annual Funding Round
items.summary: Reviewed the roster of project applications submitted for the upcoming FY26 funding cycle, which totals nearly $3.8 million in requests against $2.1 million in available funds.
